parts:
希望以下程式有所幫助:
 
# Title: Plot 2 different scale in Y-axes
# Date: 2012/7/27
# set up test data
x <-seq(-0.3,0.3, by = 0.1)

#add extra space to right margin
par(mar=c(5, 4, 4, 4) + 0.1)
# Plot first set of data and draw its axis
plot(x, b, pch=15, xlab="x", ylab="", axes=T, ylim=c(0,max(b)*1.1), type="b", col="black", main="Multiple Test Data")
axis(2, ylim=c(0,max(b)*1.1),col="black")
mtext("b1 Data", side=2, line=2.5)
box()
# Allow a second plot on the same graph
par(new=T)
# Plot the second plot and put axis scale on right
plot(x, c1, pch=16, xlab="", ylab="", axes=F, ylim=c(0,max(c1,c2)*1.05), type="b", col="red")
mtext("c1 & c2 Data", side=4, col="blue", line=2.5)
axis(4, ylim=c(0,max(c1,c2)*1.1), col.axis="blue")
# Allow a third plot on the same graph
par(new=T)
# Plot the third plot
plot(x, c2, pch=17, xlab="", ylab="", axes=F, ylim=c(0,max(c1,c2)*1.05), type="b", col="green")
# Add Legend
legend(0, max(b,c1,c2)*1.05, legend=c("b","c1","c2"), pch=c(15:17), text.col=c("black","red","green"), col=c("black","red","green"), bg = "gray90")
# end

messages.subject: Re: Ｒ畫圖的問題…X、Y、Z
parts: 程式中較重要的一行應是 par(new=T), 預設值是 FALSE, 改為TRUE 之後, 繪圖指令會保留之前已繪圖之內容, 即第1條線不會清除而繼續畫第2條線, 同理第3線亦會繪製.
